parts.text: This question is about Group I and Group VII elements.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Sodium reacts with chlorine to produce sodium chloride.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Complete the chemical equation for the reaction of sodium with chlorine. 2Na + .......... → .....NaC l [2]

ms.label: 3(b)(iv)
ms.text:
1 mark each for any two of:

high melting point / high boiling point

conducts electricity when molten

dissolves in water
